candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner so that only non-owners can withdraw.
Change the require condition to always revert by requiring false, preventing any withdrawal.
Change the transfer recipient from _recipient to msg.sender, altering who receives the funds on successful withdrawal.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Replace the transfer call with a send that returns false on failure instead of reverting, so a failed withdrawal does not revert the transaction.
